data: 80 calibration images only (device-exact int8 inputs through each ESP-PPQ graph); no TEST image or label was loaded by any exploration
rule:
Architecture selection rule for cnn_espdl_run_02 (written before variants2.json existed; calibration only, TEST never loaded).
Candidates: baseline_rerun (run_01 architecture), lite, lite_dw_down, lite_wide; numbers are the int8 (ESP-PPQ, device-exact input codes) results on the 80 calibration images.
1. Eligible: int8 FPR at 5% FNR <= baseline_rerun's + 0.010, and int8 FPR at 5% FNR within 0.005 of the same model's float value (quantization is not fragile).
2. Among eligible candidates choose the fewest MACs per frame.
3. If another eligible candidate has MACs within 25% of that one, choose the one with fewer convolution layers (esp-dl per-layer overhead and memory-bound depthwise layers make MACs an optimistic speed proxy); remaining ties: lower int8 FPR at 5% FNR.
rule_timing: rule fixed at 2026-10-23T00:56:52+09:00, after variants.json (baseline_rerun, lite, obstacle_weighted) and before variants2.json (lite_dw_down, lite_wide, written 2026-10-23T01:01:23+09:00)

not_candidates.obstacle_weighted: loss change (class-weighted BCE) on the run_01 architecture, float only; mixed per-class recall (fish 0.929 vs 0.947), no speed gain

metrics: auc: ROC area of pooled native-resolution pixels; fpr_at_fnr5: water FPR interpolated at 5% miss rate; cap5_*: constrained_threshold with cap 0.05; cap5_recall: per-class non-water recall at that threshold
